message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major detours or heavy traffic—a typical trip takes around **6 hours**. If you’re heading during rush hour or on a weekend when traffic can be heavier, you might add an extra hour or two. Always check real‑time traffic updates before you leave!
